audit.why: Mel wins every stage except level 6, where Demonic Ascension's drain out-sustains her burst inside its 650 ring. Content chart matches the packet; full chart was blanket 'Skill'.
Spikes: his 3-5 E-pull threat, his 6 (R 120s, indefinite while draining), your first item (poke outpaces sustain), your late range control. All 4 spikes present and kit-consistent.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldowns field had no digits; which Swain spells Rebuttal answers (E bird yes; W eye and R drain no) was unstated in the full layer; Do's/Don'ts bodies were pasted trade strings. Anti-heal timing (Ravenous Flock sustain) already appears in report[8].
audit.why: Kit: E Nevermove 12-10s reflectable projectile with return root+pull, W 22s ground-target eye, Q 7-3s bolts (no projectile flag in kit — not asserted either way), R 120s drain lasting while he drains champions. Mel W 38-26s.
51.72% over 990 games; EVEN framing with a Mel-tilted chart is coherent. suspectNames are false positives (Searing Brilliance and Radiant Volley are real Mel names).
